title: Pino Daniele
notes: Electric blues and mixed rhythms meet street stories, protest and Neapolitan melody.

title: Nero a metà

title: Vai mò
notes: The supergroup weaves fusion, funk and blues with sudden intimate moments.

notes: Jazz-rock and Neapolitan blues meet funk, synthesizers and international arrangements.

notes: Jazz and Latin rhythms meet electronic keyboards, horns and a small orchestra.

title: Bonne soirée

notes: Short acoustic score for Troisi: five instrumentals and one melancholy ballad.
